messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage A:
"""
Sum Insured can be changed (increased/decreased) only at the time of renewal or at any time, subject to underwriting by the company. For increase in SI, the waiting period if any shall start afresh only for the enhanced portion of the sum insured Moratorium Period: After completion of Five continuous years under the policy no look back to be applied. This period of Five years is called as moratorium period. The moratorium would be applicable for the sums insured of the first policy and subsequently completion of Five continuous years would be applicable from date of enhancement of sums insured only on the enhanced limits. After the expiry of Moratorium Period no health insurance policy shall be contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions specified in the policy contract.
"""

Passage B:
"""
4.9 Waiting Periods in days proposed, if any, for payment of benefits Name of Cover or Plan or Option Waiting Period (in Days) 4.10 Survival Periods in days proposed, if any, for payment of benefits Name of Cover or Plan or Option Survival Period (in Days) S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 4.11 Exclusions: please specify the permanent exclusions proposed for payment of benefits 4.12 Time-bound Exclusions proposed for payment of benefits Section V - Other Terms 5.1 Procedure for Renewal 5.2 Conditions for reinstatement/revival of the contract, in case of instalment premiums:
"""

Write ONE question whose full answer needs a fact from Passage A AND a fact from Passage B (e.g. combine two rules, or apply one rule to the situation in the other). If no natural question needs both, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts_a": [1-3 word-for-word spans from A], "facts_b": [1-3 word-for-word spans from B], "sub_queries": [a short search query for A's fact, a short search query for B's fact]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If I want to increase my sum insured after the moratorium period, how does the waiting period apply to the enhanced portion and what survival period should I expect for the new cover option?","answer":"After the moratorium period, the waiting period for the enhanced portion starts afresh, and the survival period for the new cover option will be the one specified in the policy’s waiting and survival period table.","facts_a":["waiting period if any shall start afresh only for the enhanced portion of the sum insured","Moratorium Period: After completion of Five continuous years under the policy no look back to be applied"],"facts_b":["Waiting Period (in Days)","Survival Period (in Days)"],"sub_queries":["\"waiting period if any shall start afresh only for the enhanced portion of the sum insured\"","\"Waiting Period (in Days)\""]}]}
